identity.name: observer
identity.oneLiner: Surface session cost and cache-read share so bloating context is visible before the bill, not after.
constraints: Must never block or delay any tool call.
Must not emit pricing data to agent context (outputs to statusLine widget only).
Must exit 0 silently on all parse/IO errors.
Must remain stdlib-only — no third-party Python packages.
Must prefer live LiteLLM pricing (cached 24h) over hardcoded fallback rates.

partyInterface.receives: Claude Code statusLine payload (transcript_path, model, context_window) via stdin
partyInterface.produces: ANSI-colored cost · cache% widget string for ccstatusline customCommands embedding

rigor.grounding: Fleet corpus N=185: cache_read = 94.8% of tokens (p50); Opus = 96.9% of spend. Source: projects/active/token-optimization/enforcer-gate-calibration.md (2026-06-17). Pricing sourced live from LiteLLM (same URL as ccusage v20.0.14): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/main/model_prices_and_context_window.json
rigor.calibration: CE-04-clear-default, CE-05-router-gate (Observer signal → Steward invocation); live pricing fetch verified 2026-06-18: claude-opus-4-8 $5/$25, claude-sonnet-4-6 $3/$15, claude-haiku-4-5 $1/$5, claude-fable-5 $10/$50
